* [[War on Terrorism]]: Arab television airs an audio tape allegedly from [[al Qaeda]] official [[Abdel Rahman al-Najdi]] saying [[Osama bin Laden]] and [[Taliban]] chief [[Mullah Omar]] are alive. The tape advocates Muslims to commit [[Terrorism|terroristic acts]] and fight the Coalition forces in [[Iraq]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.theage.com.au/articles/2003/08/18/1061059775995.html |title=Al-Qaeda tape says bin Laden alive, urges Iraqis to fight |publisher=theage.com.au |date=2003-08-19 |accessdate=2015-09-26}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://onenews.nzoom.com/onenews_detail/0,1227,214130-1-9,00.html |title=ONE News Now &#124; Daily & Breaking New Zealand News from TVNZ |publisher=Onenews.nzoom.com |accessdate=2015-09-26 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081120090046/http://onenews.nzoom.com/onenews_detail/0,1227,214130-1-9,00.html |archive-date=2008-11-20 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://abcnews.go.com/wire/World/reuters20030818_7.html |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-16 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20041009154711/http://abcnews.go.com/wire/World/reuters20030818_7.html |archive-date=2004-10-09 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
